_approach: Amen-hybrid roller: layers a chopped-amen ghost pattern (16th/32nd chatter, the sampled-break DNA drum & bass inherited from jungle) under a strict programmed two-step kick/snare skeleton and an 8th ride - the 'raw'/sample-based lineage (early Bad Company, Source Direct, Kemistry & Storm) that never fully let go of the break even as kicks and snares became programmed. Ref: docs/styles/dnb.md's note that DnB's ghost-snare micro-language descends from the amen's chop; the Akai S900/S950/S1000 break-chopping history shared with jungle.
